shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, Teddy sits at the worktable with a colored pencil hovering over the half-drawn Christmas card. He stops drawing, lifts his head and looks up toward the right, tapping the pencil against his chin once as he thinks. Then he asks his question with curious, wide eyes, tilting his head at the end of the sentence. After the line his lips close, he lowers the pencil back to the card and draws one short green line on the tree while glancing up again.
